logical_payload.prompt:
Create one task-relevant technical illustration for a readable analytical report. The report body will be typeset separately. Do not add readable writing or numerals to the illustration.

Supporting illustration for the WO-04 round-4 assurance handover. Left panel: vertical bar chart of measured energy per acceptance batch on one linear scale — P1 6, P3 14, P2 40, P4 67 kWh — each bar labeled with its tabulated value and an axis with gridlines at 0, 20, 40 and 60. Right panel: qualification margins for the same order (P1, P3, P2, P4): horizontal bars of quality margin over the 80 floor (18, 9, 6, 20 points) with numeric labels, plus five defect-slot boxes per candidate showing used defects (dark) versus spare slots (open): P1 1 used/4 spare, P3 1/4, P2 5/0, P4 5/0. Footer line states the verified pick: P1 at 6 kWh, quality 98, defects 1/5, four spare slots, all values from the trusted table drawn to scale. Colors: navy #13314a headings, green #1f6f43 energy bars, blue #2f6aa8 margin bars, white background. Static SVG pixels only; no JavaScript, event handlers or external resources.
